answers.title: Don't Repeat Yourself
answers.definition: Every piece of knowledge must have a single, unambiguous, authoritative representation within a system.

answers.title: Data Reduction Yield
answers.definition: A metric measuring the compression ratio achieved by deduplication.

answers.title: Specification-Driven Development
answers.definition: Define the specification (spec-kit, interface contracts) before writing implementation code.

answers.title: Test-Driven Development
answers.definition: Write a failing test before writing the minimum code to make it pass, then refactor.

answers.title: You Ain't Gonna Need It
answers.definition: Don't add functionality until it is actually needed. Implement only the requirements you have today.
